cards.t: Cysic bridge exploited on BNB Smart Chain
cards.b: An attacker exploited Cysic's bridge to mint 10 million tokens on BNB Smart Chain and moved funds into Tornado Cash.

per.BNB: Impacted by unauthorized token minting exploit via Cysic bridge.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total financial loss amount on BNB Smart Chain.
